QUOTE: "**Tiers 3 and 4 accumulate.** They are unioned in and survive any stated tier. Their label differs, but they behave identically."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: It says tiers 3 and 4 behave identically, but never says the distinction is deliberately inert or that the load-bearing line is fact versus guess. It only says facts beat guesses.
